electionType: Glen Rock Borough Council & Board of Education General Election
councilStructure: Borough of Glen Rock operates under the Borough form of government. 6 Borough Council members are elected at-large for staggered 3-year terms (2 elected each year), with a Mayor elected quadrennially. In 2026, Glen Rock voters elect 2 Borough Council members, alongside 3 School Board trustees.
certifiedTaxRateContext: 3.407% Total Certified Tax Rate (2026). Equalization Ratio 71.50%.
unanimousHealthBenefitPledge: Borough Council and BOE trustees adhere to state Chapter 78 healthcare contribution statutes and strict Local Government Ethics disclosures.

councilCandidates.name: Teresa Gilbreath
councilCandidates.role: Borough Council President & Finance Committee Chair
councilCandidates.experience: Incumbent Council President with extensive corporate legal background; led municipal budget reviews and shared services negotiations.
councilCandidates.tagline: Fiscally responsible borough administration, downtown revitalizations, and proactive stormwater investment.

keyPlatformPillars.title: Strict 2% Levy Cap Management
bullets: Held municipal operational increases within statutory state caps.
Led transition to private health JIF to eliminate double-digit state health insurance premium hikes.
Prioritizes pay-as-you-go capital funding for emergency vehicle replacements.

keyPlatformPillars.title: Diamond Brook Flood Mitigation
bullets: Secured Bergen County open space grants to reinforce stream banks and culverts.
Expanded annual road resurfacing schedules across all borough quadrants.

councilCandidates.name: Amy Martin
councilCandidates.experience: Incumbent Borough Councilwoman; elected in November 2023 for a 3-year term (January 2024 – December 2026); healthcare administrator and active liaison to Glen Rock Police and Volunteer Fire.
councilCandidates.tagline: Pedestrian crosswalk safety, volunteer emergency services support, and sustainable green community programs.

keyPlatformPillars.title: Pedestrian & Commuter Rail Safety
bullets: Implemented lighted crosswalks along Rock Road and Maple Avenue corridors.
Enhanced School Resource Officer (SRO) coordination with Glen Rock public schools.
Modernized emergency equipment for the Volunteer Fire Department and Volunteer Ambulance Corps.

keyPlatformPillars.title: Community Inclusion & Environmental Trust
bullets: Expanded municipal environmental commission programs and shade tree canopy replantings.
Promotes transparent online streaming of council workshops and committee reports.

councilCandidates.name: Robert E. Saydah
councilCandidates.experience: Longtime Glen Rock resident with senior corporate executive and capital budgeting credentials.
councilCandidates.tagline: Line-item fiscal auditing, tax relief for homeowners, and defending suburban zoning.

keyPlatformPillars.title: Taxpayer Watchdog & Spending Restraint
bullets: Conducts rigorous forensic reviews of municipal professional service contracts.
Advocates zero tax rate hikes to relieve burden on fixed-income seniors and young families.
Pledges complete municipal budget transparency before public hearings.

keyPlatformPillars.title: Defending Single-Family Character
bullets: Vigorously defends Glen Rock's master plan against high-density residential overdevelopment.
Protects suburban residential neighborhood aesthetics and commuter parking availability.

councilCandidates.name: Elizabeth R. Carr
councilCandidates.experience: Civic leader with private sector data analytics and operational efficiency background.
councilCandidates.tagline: Government accountability, infrastructure modernization, and small business support.

keyPlatformPillars.title: Operational Efficiency & Cost Containment
bullets: Streamlines municipal administrative overhead through modern digital services.
Explores expanded interlocal shared service agreements with Ridgewood and Bergen County.

keyPlatformPillars.title: Infrastructure & Park Accountability
bullets: Demands rigorous independent contractor oversight on capital paving and park projects.
Prioritizes traffic calming around elementary school zones.

boeCandidates.name: Damali Robinson
boeCandidates.term: Vote for up to 3 • 3-Year Full Term (2027–2029)
boeCandidates.experience: Incumbent BOE Trustee; elected November 2023 for a 3-year term (January 2024 – December 2026); corporate strategist and active parent volunteer.
boeCandidates.keyFocus: Academic excellence, STEM curriculum integration, and student mental wellness support.

boeCandidates.infrastructureStance: Continuing facility modernizations, HVAC improvements, and campus security enhancements across all 6 schools.

interviewStances.keyInterviewQuote: Our public schools are the heart of Glen Rock; we must invest wisely to maintain our top state rankings.
interviewStances.keyPriorities: Classroom instruction, mental wellness, and 2% cap fiscal discipline.
interviewStances.facilitiesAndBudget: Transparent budgeting and energy-efficient school facilities.

boeCandidates.name: Elizabeth Calvez
boeCandidates.term: Vote for up to 3 • 3-Year Full Term (2027–2029)

interviewStances.keyPriorities: Special education inclusion, early literacy, and community transparency.
interviewStances.facilitiesAndBudget: Cost-effective special education case management and fiscal cap discipline.

interviewStances.facilitiesAndBudget: Classroom-first budgeting and competitive educator contracts.

boeCandidates.name: Danielle Seltzer

boeCandidates.infrastructureStance: Upgrading high-speed campus networking and modern digital classroom security.
